shared_elements: standing human figure in profile/side view
figures shown moving or facing to one side
a horizontal ground line or base beneath the figures
justification: Both depict upright human figures in side view standing on a horizontal base line, but that is a near-universal convention; A shows two identical schematic silhouette figures inside a curved boat with upturned prow and stern, while B shows a naturalistically modelled two-humped camel led by a costumed attendant above a band of rosettes. Element specificity, relationships (boat-borne pair vs animal-and-handler) and drawing conventions (flat blocky stick-like silhouettes vs modelled anatomical relief with rendered eyes, harness and drapery) diverge almost completely.
